status: application of the frozen V0.5 static conditional-logit model; exploratory, no new evaluation, no new training, no sealed or external test
purpose: relative terrain-only shares inside a local comparison group (sum = 100 %), shown on a 3D terrain view
not_claimed: geographic generalisation beyond the V0.5 cross-validation

model.provenance: reports/v05/cv_results.json (final_models); trained on all 418 V0.5 groups, i.e. on events that were already seen; read only, never refitted here
model.score: linear conditional-logit score; share = softmax of the score inside the comparison group

terrain.dem: same read-only Skadi tile cache as V0.5 (data/raw/terrain, data/v04/cache/terrain_tiles); never downloaded here
terrain.reference_date_rule: every DEM tile must have a provider Last-Modified date before this date; no event day exists in this application

land_cover.source: CORINE CLC2018 vector via EEA discomap, polygons fetched per area envelope
land_cover.ambiguous_or_missing: cell excluded and counted (V0.4/V0.5 rule: no or several polygons = missing)

area.inside_austria: area centre and every custom point must lie inside the GISCO Austria boundary
area.heat_layer: every eligible cell; share = softmax over all eligible cells of the area, shown as index = share * N (1.0 = area average) and rank percentile

comparison_group.draw: numpy PCG64 permutation of the eligible cell ids (sorted); walk it and accept a cell >= separation_m (EPSG:31287 metres) from every accepted cell; stop at size

custom_points.rule: user-chosen points form their own comparison group; each point is evaluated at its 30 m DEM cell

recent_rain_layer.status: optional, separate, never an input of the score; V0.5 found no established benefit of weather
recent_rain_layer.source: GeoSphere INCA v1 hourly precipitation, one point at the area centre
recent_rain_layer.label: Niederschlag der letzten Tage, keine Bodenfeuchte

cache.key: SHA-256 of request and this configuration; sidecar SHA-256 verified on every read
